facts: Language resource quality is crucial in NLP.
Many resources used are derived from data.
Many resources used are derived from data created by human beings.
The derivation of resources especially regards MT and reference translations.
High-quality data allow the comparison of both automatic and human translations.
Validation of resources is widely recommended.
Validation of resources is recommended before use.
The paper describes the impact of using different-quality references on evaluation.
Similar scores are obtained in many cases regardless of the quality.
The limitations of the automatic metrics used within MT are discussed.
